anti_scam.subtitle: Safeguarding the magic of collecting
anti_scam.section1_text: Our absolute priority is to ensure a safe marketplace for everyone. My Kpop Binder is a trusted space where every trade and sale must be conducted under the highest standards of honesty.
anti_scam.section2_text: The following actions are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disciplinary action:
anti_scam.fake_text: Selling or trading fanmade items presented as official.
anti_scam.no_shipping_text: Not shipping the item after receiving payment or agreeing to a trade.
anti_scam.damage_text: Manipulating photos or descriptions to omit physical defects on the cards.
anti_scam.section3_text: Any user involved in proven fraud will permanently lose access to their account. The integrity of the community is not negotiable.

artist_month.history_p1: Formed in 2017 through the reality show of the same name by JYP Entertainment, Stray Kids (SKZ) is not a conventional K-pop group. Since their inception, the members have been involved in composing and producing their own music, led by their producing sub-unit: 3RACHA.

artist_month.fact_1: It was Bang Chan who selected the members before presenting them to the agency.
artist_month.fact_2: They are the first 4th generation group to top the Billboard 200 multiple times.
artist_month.news_text: Immersed in their world tour, and after renewing their contracts, they have promised STAY to keep producing their "noise" for many years to come.

community_rules.subtitle: Taking care of our favorite corner of the fandom
community_rules.rule1_text: My Kpop Binder is a safe space for everyone. We do not tolerate hate, bullying, or discrimination based on tastes, groups, or biases. We celebrate the diversity of the community.
community_rules.rule2_text: Keep your binders updated and be honest about the condition of your cards on the Market. Trust between users is what makes this exchange magical.
community_rules.rule3_text: When talking to other collectors for a trade or sale, be polite. We are all here for the same passion. A "hello" and a "thank you" go a long way.
community_rules.rule4_text: Do not share sensitive data publicly. Always follow our Anti-Scam policies and report any suspicious behavior so we can act quickly.

copyright.section2_text: Users who upload photos of their own photocards or customize their digital binders retain the rights to their photographic compositions, but guarantee that such content does not infringe the rights of third parties or serve illicit commercial purposes.
copyright.section3_text: The use of photocard thumbnails and album names is done under the principle of Fair Use, in order to identify, organize, and facilitate private exchange between fans, without the intention of supplanting the official commercialization of the agencies.

faq.subtitle: Essential guide for all collectors

questions.q1: What do the acronyms WTS, WTT, and OTW mean?
questions.a1: They are standard terms in collecting: WTS (Want To Sell) for sale; WTT (Want To Trade) for exchange; and OTW (On The Way) for purchased cards in transit.
questions.q2: How do I add a card that isn't in the database?
questions.a2: Use the 'Custom PC' feature. You can upload your own photos and fill in the details manually so your binder looks perfect.
questions.q3: Is it safe to buy on the Market?
questions.a3: My Kpop Binder facilitates the connection between users. Remember that shipping and the condition of the card are the seller's responsibility; we always recommend asking for video proofs.
questions.q4: What are the advantages of the Premium plan?
questions.a4: Unlock unlimited binders, exclusive grid formats (like the giant 1x1), and premium cover designs for your collection.
questions.q5: How do I mark my 'Biases' so the heart appears?
questions.a5: Set your favorites in the 'Me' section. Once chosen, their cards will automatically glow with a pink heart throughout the site.

faq.more_questions: Do you have any other questions?

market_rules.subtitle: Rules for coexisting in a magical market
market_rules.section1_text: My Kpop Binder acts only as a technological intermediary to facilitate contact between fans. It is essential to maintain transparency in every deal.
market_rules.section1_sub1_text: Payments are made externally or through secure gateways. The platform may apply technical fees for the service.
market_rules.section1_sub2_text: The seller must clearly indicate the condition of the card: damage, scratches, or manufacturing marks.
market_rules.section2_text: Trades are direct agreements between users. For your safety, we recommend always asking for verification videos (proofs) of the photocards' condition before closing the deal.
market_rules.section3_text: Both packaging and physical transport are the sole responsibility of the users involved. My Kpop Binder is not responsible for losses by courier companies or discrepancies after shipping.
market_rules.section4_text: Any attempt at fraud, selling fakes, or deception will result in immediate expulsion from the community. We ensure a safe environment for everyone.

privacy.subtitle: Protecting the privacy of all collectors
privacy.section1_text: At My Kpop Binder, we take your privacy very seriously. The data we collect (such as your email and username) is used exclusively to manage your account and improve your experience on the platform. Your data is stored encrypted and securely through Supabase.
privacy.section2_text: We implement technical measures to protect your information against unauthorized access. Access to your account is personal and non-transferable, and each user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their password.
privacy.section3_text: We use the information to personalize your collection, allow you to interact in the Marketplace, and send you important notifications about the service. We will never share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes without your explicit consent.
privacy.cookies_text: My Kpop Binder uses technical cookies and local storage to remember your preferences, such as your selected "Biases" and your session status. These tools are necessary for the interface to function correctly and to offer you smooth browsing.
privacy.gdpr_text: We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time.

report.subtitle: Official reporting channel under the DSA regulation
report.section1_text: My Kpop Binder complies with the European Union's Digital Services Act (DSA). We take proactive measures to prevent the spread of illegal content and allow all users to report violations simply and transparently.
report.section2_text: Any activity that puts the safety of the community at risk or breaks the law can be reported:
report.section2_item1_text: Scam attempts, payment deception, or items never sent.
report.section2_item2_text: Offensive, discriminatory, or intellectual property-infringing material.
report.section2_item3_text: Identity theft or selling fanmade items as official.
report.section3_text: After receiving a report, our team humanly evaluates the case. Depending on the severity, actions can range from a warning or content removal to permanent account suspension for fraud or repeat offenses.
